title: Appending a bit to a Boolean word
statement: For every bit $b \in \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and every finite Boolean word $x$, there exists a space usage $s \in \mathbb{N}$ such that the machine that appends $b$ halts after exactly $|x|+1$ steps on input $x$, has output $x$ followed by $b$, and uses exactly $s$ work-tape cells.
